findings.title: Empty check runs before interpolation
findings.body: In runSplitQuery the code filters request.targets by !query.hide and query.expr and only then maps through datasource.applyTemplateVariables. A query whose expr is a variable that interpolates to empty string (e.g. expr='$var' with empty value) passes the truthy check and is then split, grouped and executed via runQuery. It should be ignored like other empty queries. The filter for empty expr must run after interpolation, not before. Same pattern exists in shardQuerySplitting.ts.

findings.title: Shard path interpolates twice via nested runSplitQuery
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery now maps every target through datasource.applyTemplateVariables and then calls runSplitQuery on each shard sub-request, and runSplitQuery maps through applyTemplateVariables again. The updated test proves it: a single target causes 5 applyTemplateVariables calls. This is redundant work on every dashboard query and risks freezing range-dependent variables to the outer range instead of the split range if interpolation is not idempotent. The inner time-splitting path should reuse the already-interpolated queries.
